LanguageData.WotF_ElvenLongbow.description: A longbow bent along the natural grain of a single length of livingwood and strung with supple sinew. It draws light and silent, and a spell inscribed into its grip rides every arrow loosed toward the target.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenLongbow.label: livingwood longbow
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenLongsword.description: A slender, well-balanced traditional elven blade, equally suited to a flowing slash or a clean thrust. A spell inscribed into its hilt discharges the moment the edge strikes home.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenLongsword.label: elven longsword
LanguageData.WotF_Projectile_ElvenArrow.label: elven arrow
LanguageData.WotF_SpellStaff.description: A long-hafted staff meant to be steadied with both hands. Next to a nimble one-handed wand, a staff feels cumbersome and leaves little room for extra defensive gear in close quarters; in return, it withstands far fiercer surges of mana, casts spells across greater range, and is one of the rare conduits able to channel supra spells stably.
LanguageData.WotF_SpellStaff.label: spell staff
LanguageData.WotF_SpellWand.description: A one-handed wand—not to be confused with a two-handed staff!\nWands are favored by elves who lean toward swordsmanship. Lighter than a two-handed staff, a wand looses spells faster and weaves them seamlessly into bladework, at the cost of shorter range and narrower spell capacity.
LanguageData.WotF_SpellWand.label: spell wand
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Adept.description: A spellbook reforged through a tier-2 ritual, its binding and pages strengthened to hold intricate mana circuits. It unlocks all 10 spell bookmarks with up to 7 runes per spell, further raises the wearer's mana capacity and recovery, and still cannot hold supra runes.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Adept.label: adept spellbook
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Apprentice.description: An introductory spellbook worn at the hip by elves new to spellweaving. It opens all 10 spell bookmarks with up to 4 runes per spell, modestly raises the wearer's mana capacity and recovery, and cannot hold supra runes.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Apprentice.label: apprentice spellbook
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Archmage.description: A high-tier tome elevated by a starlight ritual, a cool silver sheen drifting across its pages. It opens all 10 spell bookmarks, extends each rune chain up to 10 runes, and greatly boosts the wearer's mana capacity and recovery. It is the only spellbook capable of holding supra runes, though casting a supra spell still requires wielding a staff in the main hand.
LanguageData.WotF_Spellbook_Archmage.label: starlight codex
